features.name: fried_core_signal
features.description: Approximation of the Friedman regression core signal: 10*sin(pi*X1*X2) approximated via smooth polynomial proxy plus quadratic and linear terms scaled into normalized range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a near-linear projection of the underlying generating signal that aligns well with linear SVM margins.

features.name: x1_x2_interaction
features.description: Multiplicative interaction between X1 and X2, capturing the dominant nonlinear term in the Friedman generator.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linearizes a key bilinear term so the SVM can exploit it directly.

features.name: x3_centered_sq
features.description: Squared deviation of X3 from 0.5, capturing curvature on X3.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth quadratic basis function for linear models to capture curvature on X3.

features.name: informative_sum
features.description: Weighted sum of the informative features X1-X5 emphasizing their relative scale per Friedman generator.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized weighted score useful as a direct linear margin contributor.

features.name: noise_block_mean
features.description: Mean of X6-X10, the non-informative features; should be near 0.5 if no leakage, useful as a control axis.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a baseline averaging signal that a linear SVM can down-weight automatically.

features.name: informative_vs_noise_gap
features.description: Difference between mean of informative block (X1-X5) and noise block (X6-X10).
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous severity-style contrast that lines up with a linear decision boundary.

features.name: x4_x5_ratio
features.description: Smoothed ratio between X4 and X5 using log1p to keep range bounded and stable.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a stable smoothed ratio feature that injects a log-scale linear contribution.

features.name: x1x2_minus_x3sq
features.description: Contrast between bilinear X1*X2 term and quadratic X3 centered term reflecting Friedman structure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines two key generator terms into a single discriminative axis suitable for linear margins.

features.name: informative_l2_norm
features.description: Euclidean norm of informative features X1-X5, providing a continuous magnitude measure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth magnitude feature serving as an isotropic severity score for the linear SVM.

features.name: x4_high_indicator_soft
features.description: Soft indicator of X4 being in the upper half, scaled smoothly via clipping for SVM-friendly margins.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth bounded coefficient on the highly weighted X4 feature.

features.name: feature_dispersion
features.description: Range (max minus min) across all 10 features, capturing row-level dispersion.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures whether row values are clustered or spread, providing a continuous auxiliary axis.
features.formula: np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(X1, X2), np.maximum(X3, X4)), np.maximum(X5, X6)), np.maximum(np.maximum(X7, X8), np.maximum(X9, X10))) - np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(X1, X2), np.minimum(X3, X4)), np.minimum(X5, X6)), np.minimum(np.minimum(X7, X8), np.minimum(X9, X10)))

features.name: semantic_signal_strength
features.description: Semantic assessment of how strongly a row exhibits the canonical Friedman signal pattern, evaluated as a smooth heuristic from informative-feature alignment: high when X1, X2, X4 are large and X3 is far from 0.5, low otherwise. Computed as a bounded blended score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic interpretable severity score that is approximately linear in the underlying generator and complements raw composites.
